ModMetaData.name: Research: Organized
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Sorts research projects into tech-level tabs and lays each tab out as a tidy, readable tree.
Tabs - Projects are grouped into Primitive, Neolithic, Medieval, Industrial, High and Late Industrial, Spacer, Ultra, Archotech, Anomaly and Miscellaneous tabs. - Combine All Tabs puts every project except Anomaly and Gravship on the Main tab, with each tech level in its own block from left to right. - Combine Industrial merges High and Late Industrial back into one Industrial tab. - Tab tooltips show completed projects and research points, and the counts can be shown on the tabs too. - Empty tabs are hidden.
Layout - Every tab gets a clean, non-overlapping layout with fewer crossing lines. - Follow-ups sit to the right of what they depend on, and branches fill the free space beside their prerequisites instead of trailing off the end of the tab. - A project is raised to the tech level of its prerequisites, so a follow-up never sits in an earlier era than what it needs. Its research cost changes to match. - Projects caught in a circular dependency are outlined in red and named in the log.
Look - Cards are tinted by tech level, with configurable colours that can also be turned off. - A gear in the research window opens the mod settings.
Compatibility - Node Research: foundation technologies get a gold corner mark, emergence nodes stay beside their branch without cluttering lines, and you can switch freely between its node view and these tabs. - ProgressionLESS: loads after every mod in the suite, so their research lands in the right tabs. - VFE Tribals: its Basics tab takes the Primitive projects.
